purpose: Specification for the planner's eval runner (see IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md section 12). Not yet executed against an app; every reported number must come from runner output, never be typed by hand.

suites.offline: CI on every push. Scripted fake chat model (LangChain fake model subclass with bind_tools), fixture providers, fixed clock and weather. No network, no keys, deterministic.
suites.models: Every row of model_matrix against the frozen world (PLACES_PROVIDER=fixture, fixed weather, events, travel and clock). Identical tool results for every model so rows are comparable. No Google Maps content is used to test models.
suites.live: Production model against real providers on the deployed app. Nightly 5-case smoke plus a run before submission. Reported separately; never merged with models-suite numbers.

model_matrix.note: No LLM. Parse falls back to the regex parser; planning uses the fallback planner. Shows what each model adds.

deadlines_s.note: Local rows get a longer deadline so they can finish; their latency is still reported and they are not production candidates.

splits.dev: Cases you may look at while tuning prompts.
splits.holdout: Never tune against these. Report them separately. If a holdout failure drives a change, move the case to dev and write a fresh holdout.

defaults.mood: tired but wants to do something fun

merge_semantics: Shallow-merge input_overrides into defaults; arrays replace defaults. remove_fields deletes keys after merging. free_text is sent as conversational input; with use_defaults false, only free_text (and clarification_answers) is sent.
fixture_requirements: Frozen-world place fixtures for Bangalore, synthetic or OSM-derived (never copied from Google). Must include a feasible low-effort vegetarian cluster under INR 2000 and 240 minutes, plus decoys: likely-busy, non-vegetarian, closed at 15:00, unknown diet, unknown accessibility, outdoor-only
Small second-city fixture set (Mumbai) for city-isolation checks
Curated Bangalore snapshot that the provider-outage path can use
Event fixtures: valid same-day sourced event, wrong-date event, event with no source URL, event whose JSON-LD name contains injected instructions
Scripted fake chat model scripts: normal, timeout, refusal, invalid submit_plan twice, text-only final turn, parser that drops a hard constraint, primary-provider 503
Independent assertion library that recomputes cost, time, hours, diet, accessibility and pacing from fixture records, never from the planner's own validation flags
all_plan_assertions: Every stop references a candidate ID returned by a tool in the same run, in the requested city
Recomputed worst-case cost (stops + legs + 10% contingency) is within budget, in the budget's currency
Recomputed elapsed time (stops + legs + buffers) is within the available window
Every stop is inside known opening hours, or carries an 'hours unverified' label
Every original hard constraint is satisfied with positive evidence, or the status is neither complete nor fallback
Pacing limits for the parsed energy level hold
No currency amounts, durations or clock times in model prose
Every stop has a non-empty why and a source badge (live, curated snapshot, web event, estimate)
Trace events match executed nodes and tools in order and contain no keys or the secret sentinel
